# Gilbert Blythe & Una Meredith

- [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) — Saved — [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) — since v5  <sub>[v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P16](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0016)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> Cornelia Elliott discusses the minister's children and their graveyard performance with [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Susan](../character/susan.md), and [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md). Prompted by Cornelia's feedback, Mr. Meredith confronts his children about singing in the churchyard during the prayer meeting. After addressing their thoughtlessness gently, Mr. Meredith mourns his parenting abilities and longs for [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md).
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P1](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0001), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P10](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0010), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P22](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0022), [v5 CHAPTER XXVII. A SACRED CONCERT P26](../source/v05-c27.md#nw-v05-c27-p0026)_

> The [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) decides to fast for a day as self-punishment, but the lack of food causes [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) to faint during the church service. Doctor [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) revives her and prescribes a solid meal, leaving [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) guilt-ridden about neglecting his motherless children.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P0](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0000), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P11](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0011), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P16](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0016), [v5 CHAPTER XXVIII. A FAST DAY P26](../source/v05-c28.md#nw-v05-c28-p0026)_

> Jerry decrees punishments for his siblings' cowardice, ordering [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely completes the ordeal in a chilling rainstorm, but comes down with severe pneumonia as a result. After fighting through a dangerous crisis with Dr. Blythe's care, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers and is welcomed back by his friends and family.
